subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support for conversation IDs while preserving existing account-scoped bind behavior?
rationale: The bug is real, but `--bind <channel>:<value>` is already a documented account form; choosing whether Feishu conversation IDs are auto-detected, explicit peer syntax is required, or account semantics change is a product/API compatibility decision.

options.title: Recognize Feishu conversation IDs only
options.body: Keep documented account syntax for unknown values and map well-known Feishu conversation IDs such as group/direct identifiers into `match.peer` with tests and docs.

options.title: Add explicit peer-kind syntax
options.body: Require users to write a peer-specific form such as `feishu:group:<id>` and preserve every existing two-segment bind as an account bind.

options.title: Adopt this PR's default reinterpretation
options.body: Make `feishu:<id>` mean group peer and require `feishu:account:<id>` for account binds, accepting the upgrade/documentation burden.

recommendation.title: Recognize Feishu conversation IDs only
recommendation.body: Keep documented account syntax for unknown values and map well-known Feishu conversation IDs such as group/direct identifiers into `match.peer` with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras introduced the account-scoped bind command surface whose public semantics are at stake.
